statusReason: 13.1/§12: scalpComfortTarget is low confidence because exact-product claims name ingredients absent from the canonical INCI (Ceramide complex, Kaktus-Extrakt, Vitamin E); per §2 an unresolved conflict that could change a property keeps that property low, which makes the candidate not_finalizable. The projection below is provisional (what the rules yield if the conflict resolves with the current INCI confirmed).

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: Sodium Laureth Sulfate #2 buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine #4 and Cocamide MEA #9; Sodium Xylenesulfonate #3 hydrotrope, TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate #17 trace; no reset intent (C1).
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: SLES chassis in a 'sanft reinigend' sensitive positioning

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: silicone/cationic system (Dimethiconol #7, Dimethicone #13, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #14) plus pearlizing Glycol Distearate #10; no prominent humectant (Butylene Glycol #23, Aloe #24 late), so the full C2 four-route pattern is not met.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: early silicone gum + cationic + pearlizer resembles C2

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: depositionLoad moderate (early Dimethiconol #7, Dimethicone #13, guar #14), persistence moderate, resetCapacity moderate (SLES/betaine). W1-type silicone + cationic in an effective sulfate/betaine base without rich 2-in-1 architecture.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: one meaningfully persistent silicone/cationic system with effective reset
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: high needs converging persistent systems or rich architecture with limited reset (W1)

focusPrimary.rationale: scalp_active: anti-dandruff positioning ('Anti-Schuppen Wirkung mit Pirocton Olamin', 'schuppenfreie Kopfhaut') with recognized active Piroctone Olamine #6, plus itchy/dry-scalp soothing positioning (7.2).
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Recognized active + anti-dandruff/anti-itch scalp role -> scalp_active.

focusSecondary.rationale: Scalp moisture/soothing claims are part of the scalp_active role (Appendix A); no independent lengths route.

usageRole.rationale: Treatment: supported anti-dandruff formula with problem-led positioning ('bei regelmäßiger Anwendung').

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Provisional not_targeted, low confidence: the product is explicitly positioned for 'trockene, juckende Kopfhaut' / 'Kopfhautjucken', but the canonical formula is a standard SLES/silicone anti-dandruff chassis with Menthol #16 and early Parfum #12 and no comfort/humectant route before fragrance (Aloe #24 late). The manufacturer attributes the soothing role to a Ceramide complex, Kaktus-Extrakt and Vitamin E that are absent from the INCI - an unresolved claim/formula conflict that could flip this property (§2, §12).
scalpComfortTarget.counterSignal: explicit anti-itch / dry-scalp positioning; Piroctone addresses dandruff-linked itch

dandruffSupport.rationale: Complete INCI contains Piroctone Olamine #6 (also named in claims).

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W moderate: fine acceptable, normal ideal, coarse acceptable (C moderate). T6 (dandruff target): nothing not_suited. T4: W neighbor high -> fine not_suited lifted back to acceptable by T6 (no flag), normal ideal -> acceptable (review_thickness_boundary normal), coarse would rise to ideal (no flag); C neighbor high raises coarse (no flag).
projection.scalpTargetRationale: S-DANDRUFF: E2 'Anti-Schuppen Wirkung', 'schuppenfrei' on manufacturer page (E1 moderate) + supported -> pass. S-SENSITIVE ('Kopfhautjucken', 'beruhigend') and S-DRY ('trockene Kopfhaut') claims qualify under E2 but both formula gates fail: scalpComfortTarget not targeted and no prominent comfort/humectant route (only Aloe #24 and Butylene Glycol #23, after Parfum #12, neither listed). S-FAIL does not apply because dandruff qualifies. S-FOCUS satisfied.
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1 moderate -> regular; equals schuppen expectation; no neighbor -> no I3.

uncertainties: §2/§12: claims name ingredients missing from the canonical INCI (Ceramide complex, Kaktus-Extrakt/Opuntia, Vitamin E/Tocopherol). The standard says to keep an affected property low or block identity but does not define when a claim/INCI mismatch is 'material'. Treated as material for scalpComfortTarget -> needs_research.
T4 'after T6 is applied' wording: for a scalp-concern product, a W neighbor that would make fine not_suited is neutralised by T6; applied literally (no fine flag).
If the INCI is confirmed and scalpComfortTarget becomes moderate not_targeted, the provisional projection stands as written.
